name: Liquid Energy
long_description:
Liquid Energy delivers the most scalable and cost effective inference. Our compute is hosted in our proprietary data center modules that we call NanoDC - the Nano Data Center. 

NanoDC is engineered to be rapidly deployable and scalable without traditional bottlenecks like power, permitting, and supply chains. Using NanoDC, Liquid Energy is able to provide the most efficient and sustainable way to scale compute to meet global AI demand.
one_liner: Self contained solar-powered AI inference modules: the NanoDC
